weeks.title: Week 1 · Speaking: Studying in a Foreign Country（海外留学）
objectives: 能够用英语表达留学理由并参与班级讨论
掌握教室采访的基本问答用语
完成 2-3 分钟留学视频的脚本规划与录制
weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

Week 1 introduces studying abroad. Through class discussion and a mingle interview activity, learn about classmates’ study choices and plan the first 2–3 minute speaking video, “Why we are studying abroad and in Australia”. The course also introduces Moodle, the assessment timeline and group-work requirements. 本周是课程第一周，主题是海外留学（studying abroad）。你将通过全班讨论和教室巡回采访（mingle）活动了解彼此的留学选择，开始规划第一个口语任务——2-3 分钟视频「Why we are studying abroad and in Australia」。课程同时介绍 Moodle 平台、考核时间线与小组合作要求。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Discuss popular study-abroad countries, cities and emerging destinations, exchanging views and trying to reach agreement. 口语讨论：就热门留学国家、城市与新兴目的地交换观点，尝试达成共识
  • Stand up and interview as many classmates as possible, record their answers and compare similarities. 采访练习：起立采访尽可能多的同学，记录答案并比较相似度
  • Plan the video structure with your partner; record it in a quiet location in Session 2. 视频脚本：与搭档规划视频结构，Session 2 找安静地点完成录制
  • Complete the Week 1 online module on Moodle. 在线模块：完成 Moodle 上 Week 1 online module

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • Express reasons using because, due to, the reason why and one factor is that. 表达原因：because、due to、the reason why、one factor is that
  • Describe trends using gain momentum and an increasing number of. 描述趋势：gain momentum（逐渐流行）、an increasing number of
  • Speak loudly and clearly, look at the camera, vary your intonation and pay attention to body language. 演讲技巧：speak loudly and clearly、look at the camera、vary your intonation、be aware of your body language

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • Prepare script keywords rather than memorising every sentence so that delivery sounds natural. 脚本记关键词而非整句背诵，说话更自然
  • Share speaking time equally; avoid one partner delivering the whole presentation. 两人分工均衡（speak equally），避免一人独讲
  • The retained task instructions say the video does not need uploading to Moodle, but must be saved for analysis in Week 2. 视频无需上传 Moodle，但须保存好，Week 2 要回看分析
  • Watch for excessive speaking speed, lack of camera contact and reasons that are not explained specifically. 常见问题：语速过快、忽视镜头、理由阐述不具体

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

Use this week’s recording in Week 2 to identify and improve cause-and-effect language before the group presentation. 本周录制的视频是 Week 2 听力课的素材：你将回看视频、找出因果表达并改进，为小组展示做准备。

  • Reading 阅读定位法：先看题干找定位词（专有名词/数字/核心概念）→ 扫读找同义替换 → 精读定位句前后各一句再作答；推断题严禁脑补，警惕把原文 may/could 偷换成 must/always。

  • Speaking / Writing 学术升级：先用自己的话概括核心观点（Processing Text & Transformation），再替换为学术表达（模糊限制语 tend to / arguably + 转述动词 contend / demonstrate + 名词化）。

本周围绕 Studying abroad destinations、Reasons for studying in Australia 等 展开。下面是针对本周内容的具体提分建议：

① 围绕本周话题做输出练习

本周核心话题：Studying abroad destinations、Reasons for studying in Australia、Class mingle and interviews、Planning a 2-3 minute spoken video。课后选一个话题，做 2–3 分钟口头复述或写一段 80–100 词短文，刻意套用本周目标句型和重点词汇。

② 对照能力目标自检
  • 能够用英语表达留学理由并参与班级讨论
  • 掌握教室采访的基本问答用语
  • 完成 2-3 分钟留学视频的脚本规划与录制
③ 重点词汇巩固

本周关键表达：study abroad（Study abroad: a period of academic study at an educational institution in another country, often to gain a different perspective, language practice and international exposure. 中文：留学（出国学习））、popular destination（Popular destination: a place that attracts a large number of visitors or migrants because of its attractions, opportunities or reputation. 中文：热门目的地）、gain momentum（Gain momentum: to increase in strength, speed or support over time, often used to describe a movement, trend or campaign that is becoming more powerful. 中文：逐渐流行、势头增强）、video script（A video script plans the content, order and wording of a recorded presentation. 中文：视频脚本）、mingle activity（Mingle activity: a classroom task in which learners move around the room and talk to different partners in order to exchange information and practise spoken language. 中文：教室巡回采访活动）、intonation（Intonation: the rise and fall of the voice pitch across an utterance, used to convey meaning, emphasis, attitude and to signal whether a sentence is a question or a statement. 中文：语调）、online module（An online module is a structured set of learning activities and materials accessed through the course platform. 中文：在线学习模块）。建议为每个表达造一个与本周话题相关的句子，并朗读/录音回听，检查发音与语调。

④ 口语（Speaking）专项提分

找搭档用本周话题做一次 mingle / interview；用手机录下 2–3 分钟视频并回看，重点检查流利度与 intonation（语调），再用 constructive feedback 互相点评改进。

weeks.title: Week 2 · Listening: Studying in a Foreign Country（因果表达）
objectives: 能听懂并捕捉表示因果关系的语言
能用因果连接词写出正确的因果句
能根据同伴反馈改进演讲
weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

The studying-abroad theme continues through listening and writing. Listen to a short talk explaining its popularity, identify cause-and-effect expressions and write similar sentences. Then analyse the Week 1 video and present an improved version to a group. 主题延续海外留学，技能转向听力与写作。你将听一段解释留学热潮的短讲，捕捉其中表示因果关系的语言并仿写因果句；随后回看 Week 1 的视频进行自我分析，最后在小组展示改进版演讲。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • In Listening 1, note as much cause-and-effect language as possible and discuss its use with a partner. 听力捕捉：听 Listening 1，尽可能记下 cause-and-effect language 并与同伴讨论用法
  • Listen to Listening 2 and match each cause with its effect. 听力匹配：再听 Listening 2，将原因与结果配对
  • Write 2–3 cause-and-effect sentences using the ideas and expressions from the listening. 写作输出：用听到的语言与观点写 2-3 个因果句
  • Identify cause-and-effect language in your own video and practise a revised version. 视频分析：标记自己视频中的因果表达，练习新版本
  • Present the improved talk to another group and give constructive feedback using the checklist. 小组展示：向另一组表演改进版演讲并按清单给出建设性反馈

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • Signal cause and effect with because, as a result, therefore, due to, caused by, consequently and lead to. 因果连接：because、as a result、therefore、due to、caused by、consequently、lead to
  • Frame feedback with questions such as “Do the presenters clearly explain…?” and “Is it clear how…?” 反馈用语：Do the presenters clearly explain…、Is it clear how…
  • Predict the topic before listening, then listen for signal words that reveal the logical relationships. 听力技巧：先预测话题，再抓信号词（signal words）

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • Practise both patterns: “A leads to B” and “Because of A, B”. 因果句记住两种框架：A leads to B；Because of A, B
  • Give sentence-level, specific feedback rather than merely saying “good”. 同伴反馈要具体：指出句子级别的问题，而不是只说 good
  • Avoid focusing only on unfamiliar vocabulary and missing logical signals, or presenting reasons without linking them clearly to results. 常见问题：只注意生词而忽略逻辑词；演讲中理由与结果脱节

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

The Academic English Student Book lists SDG 11 Reading Guide Task 4 as due before Week 2 Tutorial 3. Week 3 introduces group work in ALSW. 阅读指南 Task 4 须在第2周第3次 Tutorial 前完成。ALSW 第3周进入小组合作主题。

Cause and effect（因果句型）

Use because + clause and because of + noun phrase. For example, “The presentation was delayed because the file was missing.” / “The presentation was delayed because of a missing file.” because 后接完整从句，because of 后接名词短语。

terms.cn: Cause and effect is the relationship between a reason or event and the result it produces. 中文：因果关系
terms.supplementaryDef: Cause and effect is the relationship between a reason or event and the result it produces.

terms.cn: As a result: a cohesive phrase introducing a consequence or effect, signalling a cause-and-effect relationship between two ideas. 中文：因此、结果
terms.supplementaryDef: As a result: a cohesive phrase introducing a consequence or effect, signalling a cause-and-effect relationship between two ideas.

terms.cn: Due to introduces a cause or reason and is followed by a noun or noun group. 中文：由于
terms.supplementaryDef: Due to introduces a cause or reason and is followed by a noun or noun group.

terms.cn: Therefore: a connective adverb introducing a logical conclusion drawn from the evidence or reasoning that has just been presented. 中文：所以
terms.supplementaryDef: Therefore: a connective adverb introducing a logical conclusion drawn from the evidence or reasoning that has just been presented.

terms.cn: Constructive feedback: comments on another person's work that identify specific strengths and offer practical, respectful suggestions for improvement rather than mere criticism. 中文：建设性反馈

weeks.title: Week 4 · Listening and Writing: Working in Groups（模糊限制语）

weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

Practise accurate listening and hedging in academic writing. Write dictated sentences, decide whether they state facts or opinions, study the hedging table and qualify the sentences. Then add suitable hedging to the Week 3 video and present the revised version. 本周训练听力精写与学术写作中的模糊限制语（hedging language）。先听写句子并讨论它们是事实还是观点，再学习 hedging 表格并改写句子；之后回看 Week 3 视频，加入 hedging 后展示改进版。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Write exactly what you hear in Listening 1 and compare your dictation with a partner. 听写：Listening 1 写下听到的句子，与同伴核对
  • Decide whether the sentences express facts or opinions and discuss how to make them more accurate. 讨论：判断句子是 facts or opinions，讨论如何改得更准确
  • Use the hedging table to rewrite absolute statements with appropriate qualifications. Hedging 学习：研读表格，把绝对化句子改写成带限定的表达
  • Exchange sentences and revise them using at least two categories, for example a modal verb and a frequency adverb. 同伴改写：抽签互换句子，至少从两个类别（如情态动词加频率副词）修改
  • Identify where hedging would improve the video, then present the revised version and receive feedback. 视频分析：找出视频中可加 hedging 的地方，展示并接受反馈

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • The modal verbs listed are might, could, may, would and should; choose the form that expresses the intended possibility, condition or recommendation. 情态动词：might、could、may、would、should
  • The listed probability expressions are possibly, probably, perhaps and certainly; note that certainly expresses strong certainty rather than weakening a claim. 概率副词：possibly、probably、perhaps、certainly
  • Frequency adverbs such as usually, often, sometimes and rarely specify how often a claim applies. 频率副词：usually、often、sometimes、rarely
  • Quantifiers such as some, many, most, a majority of and a number of limit the group covered by a statement. 量词：some、many、most、a majority of、a number of
  • Other qualifying patterns include tends to, appears to and it is possible that. 其他：tends to、appears to、it is possible that

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • Hedging makes claims proportionate to their supporting evidence rather than unnecessarily absolute. Hedging 是学术写作的命脉：它让断言有分寸、可被证据支持
  • Ask whether the claim holds in every situation. If it does not, add an appropriate qualification. 判断标准：这句话在任何情况下都成立吗？如果不成立就加限定
  • Do not add probably mechanically to every sentence; excessive hedging weakens the message. Match qualification to the evidence. 常见问题：给每个句子都加 probably，反而削弱说服力，hedging 要适度

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

Week 5 introduces natural disasters and infographic summaries, with an audio rather than video recording task. Pay attention to phone-recording technique. Week 5 转向自然灾害话题与信息图总结，口语输出从视频改为音频，请注意手机录音技巧。

Match the claim to the evidence（限定语与证据）

“Some students may find group work difficult” limits both the group and the certainty of the claim. “All students certainly find it difficult” makes a much stronger claim. 改写时保留原文的范围与确定程度。

本周围绕 Dictation and listening、Facts vs opinions 等 展开。下面是针对本周内容的具体提分建议：

① 围绕本周话题做输出练习

本周核心话题：Dictation and listening、Facts vs opinions、Hedging language、Sentence modification。课后选一个话题，做 2–3 分钟口头复述或写一段 80–100 词短文，刻意套用本周目标句型和重点词汇。

② 对照能力目标自检
  • 能通过听写准确记录句子
  • 理解学术写作中 hedging 的作用并能改写句子
  • 能在演讲中恰当使用模糊限制语
③ 重点词汇巩固

本周关键表达：hedging language（Hedging qualifies the scope or certainty of a claim so that it matches the evidence. 中文：模糊限制语）、modal verb（A modal verb works with a main verb to express meanings such as possibility, ability, obligation or recommendation. 中文：情态动词）、quantifier（A quantifier specifies the quantity or proportion of the people or things referred to, as in some, many or most. 中文：量词）、adverb of frequency（Adverb of frequency: an adverb such as always, often, sometimes, rarely or never that indicates how often an action occurs, usually placed before the main verb but after the verb to be. 中文：频率副词）、fact or opinion（Fact or opinion: a fact is a statement that can be verified as true or false with evidence, whereas an opinion is a personal view, feeling or judgment that cannot be proven. 中文：事实或观点）、dictation（Dictation: the activity in which a text is read aloud and learners write it down, used to practise listening accuracy, spelling and punctuation. 中文：听写）。建议为每个表达造一个与本周话题相关的句子，并朗读/录音回听，检查发音与语调。

④ 听力（Listening）专项提分

用 0.8× / 1.0× / 1.2× 三档倍速各听一遍材料；做关键句听写并对照 transcript 标出没听出的连读与 natural pace；抓 cause-effect、cohesive device 等信号词帮助理解。

weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

Discuss recent natural disasters worldwide and common disasters in your home country. In pairs, study an infographic, take notes and summarise its main points to a partner. Record a 2–3 minute infographic summary in Session 2. 本周主题是自然灾害（natural disasters）。先讨论近期影响世界的灾害与本国的常见灾害，再两人一组研读一张信息图（infographic），做笔记并向同伴口头总结要点；Session 2 录制 2-3 分钟的信息图总结音频。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Give examples of recent disasters and discuss disaster prevention. 话题讨论：举例近期自然灾害、分析如何防灾
  • Identify the infographic’s most important data and conclusions and record keywords. 信息图笔记：抓出最重要数据与结论，记关键词
  • Assess each oral summary for clear main points, logical progression and natural transitions. 口头总结：按要点是否清晰、流程是否逻辑、过渡是否自然等标准互评
  • For the recording, keep the phone 15–20 cm from your mouth, slow your delivery, vary intonation and minimise background noise. 音频录制：手机距嘴 15-20 cm，语速放慢、变化语调、减少背景噪音
  • Complete the Moodle Week 5 online module. 在线模块：完成 Moodle Week 5 online module

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • Describe data with reached…, stood at… and increased from… to… . 数据描述：reached…、stood at…、increased from… to…
  • Connect ideas with first of all, in addition, however and as a result, selecting the expression that fits the relationship. 过渡衔接：first of all、in addition、however、as a result
  • Organise the summary with “This infographic shows…”, “The key point is…” and “In conclusion…”. 总结框架：This infographic shows…、The key point is…、In conclusion…

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • Use an overall-topic–details–conclusion structure: one topic sentence, 2–3 key data points and one concluding sentence. 信息图总结按总-分-总：一句话主题、2-3 个数据点、一句结论
  • Make a 10-second test recording to check clarity and volume before recording the whole summary. 录音前先录 10 秒试听，检查清晰度与音量
  • Avoid stumbling over numbers or listing information without selecting the most important points. 常见问题：念数字卡顿；信息堆砌没有重点

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

Week 6 practises cohesive devices through Australian bushfires; your recording provides material for analysis. Week 6 以澳大利亚丛林大火为例精练 cohesive devices，你的音频将是分析素材。

Peer Feedback & Recording（同伴反馈与录音）

Check the key points, order, transitions and explanations of cause and effect. Note what you will improve. 互评时核对要点、顺序、衔接和因果解释，并记下改进点。

Save the 2–3 minute recording somewhere accessible in Week 6. The recording does not need to be uploaded to Moodle. Complete the Week 5 Moodle module separately. 录音保存到第六周可取用的位置，无需上传 Moodle。另行完成本周在线模块。

Checking the Evidence（核对信息图证据）

Check the period, units and denominator. If 20% of 100 households and 30% of 50 households lost power, the second group has the higher proportion, while the first has more affected households (20 versus 15). 比较前检查时间、单位和分母。本例第二组比例较高，第一组受影响户数更多。

If both measures rise, say “both increased”. Use “as a result” when the source supports a causal link. 两项指标同时上升可说 both increased。资料支持因果关系时才用 as a result。

weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

Continue the natural-disaster topic through cohesive devices. Discuss Australian bushfires and predict information from the 2019–2020 infographic. Listen twice: first for cohesion and then to complete gaps. Finally, review and improve your own audio. 本周继续自然灾害话题，聚焦衔接手段（cohesive devices）。先讨论澳大利亚丛林大火，再看 2019-2020 山火信息图并预测内容；听两遍摘要，第一遍抓衔接词，第二遍填空；最后回听自己的音频并改进。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Discuss bushfire impacts on the environment, animals and people, comparing them with disasters in your home country. 讨论：山火对环境、动物与人的影响，与本国灾害对比
  • Use the infographic’s title and visuals to predict the figures you may hear. 预测：看信息图标题与图形，预测会听到的数字
  • In Listening 1, note cohesive devices such as however, therefore, which and in addition. 听力 1：记下所有衔接词（如 however、therefore、which、in addition）
  • In Listening 2, complete the gaps and check the source-task figures, including 11.2 million hectares, 28 fatalities and 1 billion animals. These are the exercise’s historical figures, not a newly verified disaster assessment. 听力 2：填空练习，核对 11.2 million hectares、28 fatalities、1 billion animals 等数据
  • With a partner, identify cohesive devices in your recording and revise the summary. 音频分析：与同伴标记音频中的衔接手段并修订

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • Conjunctions such as and, but and because connect words or clauses. Sentence connectors such as however, therefore and moreover link ideas across sentences. 连接词：conjunctions（and、but、because）、sentence connectors（however、therefore、moreover）
  • Reference words such as this, which and these refer to information already mentioned and can reduce repetition. 指代：reference words（this、which、these）避免重复
  • Use related vocabulary, such as bushfire, flames, evacuation and wildlife, to form lexical chains that maintain the topic. 词汇链：lexical chains（bushfire、flames、evacuation、wildlife）保持话题连贯
  • Describe scale with an area comparable to…, over… and at least… . 数据表达：an area comparable to…、over…、at least…

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • Use cohesive devices where they clarify the connection between ideas. For example, use therefore for a consequence and however for a contrast. 根据句意选择衔接手段。表达结果用 therefore，表达转折用 however。
  • Avoid linking the whole summary only with and, and make each reference clear so the listener can identify what it refers to. 常见问题：通篇用 and 串联；指代不清让听者找不到主语

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

Week 7 is feedback and revision. Review the skills from the first six weeks before the integrated AI-in-education work in Week 8. Week 7 为反馈与复习周，请整理前六周的技能清单；Week 8 进入 AI in education 听说写综合训练。

terms.cn: A cohesive device connects information through language, such as a conjunction, reference word or related vocabulary. 中文：衔接手段
terms.supplementaryDef: A cohesive device connects information through language, such as a conjunction, reference word or related vocabulary.

terms.cn: Conjunction: a word such as and, but, because or although that joins words, phrases or clauses and expresses the relationship between them. 中文：连词
terms.supplementaryDef: Conjunction: a word such as and, but, because or although that joins words, phrases or clauses and expresses the relationship between them.

terms.cn: Reference word: a word such as a pronoun or demonstrative that refers back or forward to another word or phrase in the text, creating cohesion and avoiding repetition. 中文：指代词
terms.supplementaryDef: Reference word: a word such as a pronoun or demonstrative that refers back or forward to another word or phrase in the text, creating cohesion and avoiding repetition.

weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

Begin the AI-in-education unit. In Session 1, discuss 10 views about campus AI use, including AI-written work and university bans, then take notes on a panel interview with four speakers. In Session 2, use the notes to complete reporting gaps and practise reporting verbs that represent the speakers’ positions. 本周开启新单元 AI in education。Session 1 先与同伴讨论 10 条校园 AI 使用观点（如 AI 代写、大学是否应禁用 AI），再听四位嘉宾的座谈访谈（panel interview）并记笔记；Session 2 根据笔记完成转述填空，学习用 reporting verbs 转述嘉宾立场。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Discuss each statement with a partner and record agreement or disagreement. 观点讨论：与搭档逐条表态，统计 agree 与 disagree
  • Listen to the four panel speakers and note each position and its supporting reasons. 座谈听力：听四位 panel speakers 的回答，记录各自立场与理由
  • Complete 8 sentences with the correct speaker’s name and reporting verb. 转述填空：用正确的说话人姓名与 reporting verb 完成 8 个句子
  • Complete the Moodle Week 8 online module. 在线模块：完成 Moodle Week 8 online module

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • Reporting verbs include argue, claim, suggest, warn, admit and point out. Choose a verb that matches the speaker’s intent, such as proposing a view, making a claim, giving advice, warning of risk, conceding or drawing attention to a point. 转述动词：argue（主张）、claim（声称）、suggest（建议）、warn（警告）、admit（承认）、point out（指出）
  • Express your response with “I completely agree because…”, “I agree to some extent, but…” and “I see your point, but…”. 观点表达：I completely agree because…、I agree to some extent, but…、I see your point, but…
  • Topic vocabulary includes critical thinking, cheating, privacy breach and substitute. 话题词汇：critical thinking（批判性思维）、cheating（作弊）、privacy breach（隐私泄露）、substitute（替代）

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • Reporting verbs differ in stance: state is relatively neutral; claim can signal that a statement needs support; warn highlights risk. 转述动词体现立场强弱：state 中性，claim 暗示需证据，warn 强调风险
  • Take notes in three columns—speaker, position and reasons—so that they can be used directly in Session 2. 听力笔记按说话人、立场、理由三列记录，方便 Session 2 直接用
  • Do not use argue and explain interchangeably without considering their meanings, and record the supplied year, 2025, so the reference is complete. 常见问题：把 argue 和 explain 混用；漏记年份（2025）导致引用不完整

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

Week 9 classifies reporting verbs as factual or opinion-based and introduces criteria for assessing paraphrases in academic writing. Week 9 系统学习 reporting verbs 的分类（factual 与 opinion）与转述评估标准，为学术写作打基础。

weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

Focus on reporting and paraphrasing in academic writing. Match 12 reporting verbs to meanings, distinguish factual from opinion reporting and select verbs for sentence gaps. Then write and exchange paragraphs, paraphrase a partner’s ideas and evaluate the result against seven criteria. 本周专注学术写作中的转述与改写（paraphrasing）。Session 1 将 12 个 reporting verbs 与释义配对，区分报道事实与报道观点的动词，并在句子填空中选用；Session 2 与搭档互写段落，用 reporting verbs 互相转述并按七项清单评估质量。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Match argue, believe, challenge, claim, mention, point out, question, state, suggest, admit, warn and find to their intended meanings. 动词配对：argue、believe、challenge、claim、mention、point out、question、state、suggest、admit、warn、find
  • The task contrasts factual reporting verbs, such as state, find and report, with viewpoint-reporting verbs, such as argue, believe and claim. 分类：factual verbs（state、find、report）与 opinion verbs（argue、believe、claim）
  • Select an appropriate reporting verb in each of the 10 academic contexts. 句子完成：为 10 个学术语境选用恰当的 reporting verb
  • Write a 3–4 sentence paragraph, exchange it and paraphrase using the author’s surname, year and reporting verb; then assess it with the checklist. 段落互转：写 3-4 句段落，换签后用姓加年份加 reporting verb 转述，再按清单评估

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • The supplied citation patterns are “Smith (2024) argues that…” and “Tanaka et al. (2025) found…”. 引用格式：Smith (2024) argues that…、Tanaka et al. (2025) found…
  • Check seven features: surname, year, reporting-verb intent, synonymous wording, changed sentence structure, preserved meaning and formal register. 转述评估七要点：姓氏、年份、动词意图、同义替换、句式变化、语义不变、正式语体
  • Useful structures include “X challenges the traditional view of…” and “X questions whether…”. 常用结构：X challenges the traditional view of…、X questions whether…

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • A paraphrase changes wording and structure while retaining meaning; it is not word-for-word translation. 转述不等于逐字翻译：换词、换句式、保语义三件事都要做
  • When reviewing a peer’s paragraph, check first for unintended meaning changes in the paraphrase. Here “semantic change” refers to meaning drift during rewriting, rather than historical language change. 评估同学段落时先找 semantic change（语义漂移），这是最常见的错误
  • Check consistency of reporting-verb tense and ensure that a substituted word does not change the source’s degree of certainty or emphasis. 常见问题：reporting verb 时态不一致；同义替换改变了语气强弱

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

Week 10 returns to SDG 11 core-text revision and discussion in preparation for Part B of the Term 1 A1 integrated speaking assessment. Week 10 回到 SDG 11 核心文本复习与小组讨论，为 Term 1 的 A1 综合口语考试 Part B 做准备。

Use argues for a position, reports for a stated finding, and suggests for a tentative conclusion when the source supports that reading. Choose the verb after checking the original claim. 先核对原文是在提出观点、报告发现还是给出暂定结论，再选动词。

Weekly Overview（本周概览）

Prepare for the discussion component of A1. In Session 1, review three questions about the SDG 11 Sustainable Cities and Communities text, practise a fishbowl discussion and receive peer feedback against four criteria. In Session 2, review the group infographic, take notes and record an explanation. 本周为 A1 综合口语考试的讨论部分做准备。Session 1 与搭档复习核心文本（SDG 11 Sustainable Cities and Communities）的三个问题，并以 fishbowl discussion 形式在全班面前练习，接受基于四项标准的同伴反馈；Session 2 复习小组信息图内容，记笔记并录制一段讲解音频。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Review which SDG the core text addresses, why it matters and whether it can be achieved. 核心文本复习：核心文本聚焦哪个 SDG？为何重要？能否实现？
  • In a fishbowl discussion, the inner circle discusses while the outer circle observes and records feedback. 鱼缸讨论：内圈讨论、外圈观察并记录反馈
  • Use the semester’s group infographic to prepare notes and record an explanation. 信息图讲解：根据本学期小组信息图写笔记并录音
  • Complete the Moodle Week 10 online module. 在线模块：完成 Moodle Week 10 online module

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • Build on others’ contributions with “Building on your point…”, “To take that further…” and “Linking to what you said about…”. 讨论互动：Building on your point…、To take that further…、Linking to what you said about…
  • Use the four dimensions in the ALSW peer-feedback activity to review the discussion. For formal A1 assessment, consult the seven criteria in the Assessment Guide. ALSW 同伴反馈活动使用四个观察维度。正式 A1 评分请参照考核指南的七项标准。
  • Introduce evidence with “According to the text…” or “The data show that…”. State the relevant finding and explain how it supports your point. 引用证据时可以用 According to the text… 或 The data show that…，随后指出具体发现及其与观点的关系。

  • The retained speaking practice suggests a viewpoint, textual evidence and explanation delivered in 30–45 seconds. 发言公式：观点加文本证据加一句解释，30-45 秒说完
  • Do not merely repeat the text without evaluation or interrupt rather than build on another speaker’s point. 常见问题：只复述文本不加评价；打断他人而非 building on

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

Week 11 uses nominalisation to transform spoken explanations into academic written language. Week 11 转向写作，学习 nominalisation（名词化）把口语内容升级为学术书面语。

The Assessment Guide assigns A1 10% of the final Academic English result. Part A assesses individual responses to the reading. Part B involves group discussion. 课程总评中 A1 占 10%。Part A 根据阅读作个人回答，Part B 进行小组讨论。

Rubric（评分标准） · Processing Text 20%, Transformation 20%, Coherence & Organisation 10%, Intelligibility 20%, Grammar 10%, Vocabulary 10%, Interaction 10%.

weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

Practise nominalisation. In teams, identify lecture verb groups and convert them into noun groups, such as burn fossil fuels → the burning of fossil fuels. Use the nominalised forms to rewrite the lecture in an academic style. In Session 2, turn the Week 10 spoken infographic explanation into an academic paragraph. 本周学习学术写作的核心技巧——名词化（nominalisation）。先以团队竞赛形式识别讲座中的动词词组并转换成名词词组（如 burn fossil fuels 变为 the burning of fossil fuels），再用名词化形式把讲座改写成正式学术风格段落；Session 2 回听 Week 10 的信息图音频，把口语内容改写为书面学术段落。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Work in the assigned Runner, Writer and Readers roles to complete the verb-group conversion activity. 团队竞赛：分组担任 Runner、Writer、Readers，完成动词词组转换
  • Underline verbs or verbal groups and write the corresponding noun or noun group. 动词转名词：划出 verbs or verbal groups，写出对应的 noun or noun group
  • Rewrite the lecture’s climate-change causes using nominalisation: fossil fuels, food production, deforestation and methane from landfill. 讲座改写：用名词化重写气候变化成因讲座（化石燃料、粮食生产、砍伐森林、垃圾填埋甲烷）
  • Turn the spoken infographic explanation into an academic paragraph using extended noun groups. 音频转写：把信息图口语改为含 extended noun groups 的学术段落

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • The examples are the burning of fossil fuels, deforestation (from cut down trees) and methane production from landfill. 名词化：the burning of fossil fuels、deforestation（cut down trees）、methane production from landfill
  • The retained style guidance emphasises noun-group subjects, less reliance on we/you and nominalised expressions for cause and effect. 正式风格特征：名词词组作主语、少用 we 与 you、因果用名词化连接
  • The lecture topics include burning fossil fuels, food production, cutting down trees, methane produced by waste in landfills and recycling. 讲座关键内容：burning fossil fuels、food production、cutting down trees、waste in landfills produces methane、recycling

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • The retained rule of thumb associates frequent we/I with a more personal style and nominalisation with academic style. It is a style heuristic, not proof that more nominalisation always improves writing. 判断标准：一句话里 we 与 I 越多越口语，名词化程度越高越学术
  • First identify the verbs, then form suitable nouns and reorganise the subject and causal relationships. 改写顺序：先划动词，转名词，再重新组织主语与因果关系
  • Balance formality with readability; excessive nominalisation can make a sentence difficult to understand. 常见问题：名词化堆砌导致句子难懂，应平衡可读性与正式度

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

Week 12 revises parts of speech and word forms, using dangerous Australian animals to practise comparison and contrast. Week 12 学习词性与词形纠错，并以危险的澳大利亚动物巩固比较对比表达。

“The city expanded rapidly” becomes “the rapid expansion of the city”. The verb expanded becomes the noun expansion, and rapidly becomes rapid. 保留原句的动作主体和意义，再调整词形。

weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

The topic is dangerous Australian animals. In Session 1, revise parts of speech and correct word-form errors, such as Australia animals → Australian animals, then compare which animal is more dangerous. Record a 1–2 minute summary in Session 2. The retained course note identifies this as the Infographic Research Project’s deadline week; consult the actual assessment information for the date. 本周主题是危险的澳大利亚动物。Session 1 先复习词性（parts of speech），识别并纠正段落词形错误（如 Australia animals 应为 Australian animals），再两人比较哪种动物更危险；Session 2 把讨论录成 1-2 分钟口头总结。Infographic Research Project 本周截止。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Match noun, verb, adjective and adverb to their definitions and identify these categories in use. 词性识别：匹配名词、动词、形容词、副词定义并标注用词
  • Explain a word-form error using “This is a/an…, but it should be a/an…” and then correct it. 词形纠错：找出 This is a/an…, but it should be a/an… 类错误并改正
  • Compare animals using reasons and criteria such as venom or speed. 比较对比：讨论哪种动物更危险并给出理由（venom、speed 等）
  • Record a 1–2 minute spoken summary and save it for Week 13. 口头总结：录制 1-2 分钟 spoken summary，保存至 Week 13
  • Complete the Moodle Week 12 online module. 在线模块：完成 Moodle Week 12 online module

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • Topic words include venomous, anti-venom, crocodile and jellyfish. These are vocabulary items in the course task, not medical treatment instructions. 动物词汇：venomous（有毒的）、anti-venom（抗毒血清）、crocodile、jellyfish
  • Compare with “X is more dangerous than Y because…”, “Compared with X, Y…” and whereas. 比较句型：X is more dangerous than Y because…、Compared with X, Y…、whereas
  • Distinguish the noun/adjective forms nation/national and Australia/Australian. 词形：nation、national；Australia、Australian

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • Check adjective and adverb forms while proofreading, paying attention to words ending in -ly. 形容词与副词是高频错误点，写完通读一遍专查 -ly
  • Specify the measure behind a comparison; “more dangerous” needs a criterion. 比较要有标准：不能只说 more dangerous，要说 by what measure
  • The retained study advice recommends an early infographic draft because the deadline week may be busy. 常见问题：截止周时间紧，建议尽早完成信息图初稿

weeks.notesHtml:
Weekly Overview（本周概览）

In the final Term 1 week, take notes on the cane-toad audio, complete a nominalised summary and check the Week 12 recording for word-form errors. In Session 2, four group members each read a koala text, take notes under three headings, regroup to share and synthesise the information into one paragraph. 本周是 Term 1 的最后一周。Session 1 听甘蔗蟾蜍音频并记笔记，用名词化完成摘要填空，并回听 Week 12 录音纠正词形错误；Session 2 四人各读一篇考拉文本，按三个标题做笔记，重新分组分享，最后综合成一段。

Skills & Tasks（技能与任务）

  • Take notes on the cane-toad audio, including origin, reproduction and toxicity. 听力笔记：听 cane toads 音频，记录来源、繁殖、毒性等关键信息
  • Complete the summary with nouns and noun groups, using the supplied pattern “The introduction from Hawaii in 1935 led to…”. 名词化复习：用名词与名词词组完成摘要（如 The introduction from Hawaii in 1935 led to…）
  • Listen to each other’s Week 12 recording and identify word-form errors. 词形复习：互听 Week 12 录音，找出词形错误
  • Combine four koala texts through three note categories into one paragraph, checking nominalisation, word forms and synthesis. 小组综合写作：四篇考拉文本、三类笔记、综合成一段，注意 nominalisation、word forms 与 synthesis

Core Language Points（核心语言点）

  • Topic vocabulary includes habitat, conservation, threats and eucalyptus. 考拉主题词：habitat（栖息地）、conservation（保护）、threats、eucalyptus（桉树）
  • The nominalisation example is “their contribution to the decline of other species may be attributed to their toxicity”. 名词化范例：their contribution to the decline of other species may be attributed to their toxicity
  • Synthesis patterns include “While some texts emphasise…, others highlight…” and “Taken together, these texts suggest…”. 综合句式：While some texts emphasise…, others highlight…、Taken together, these texts suggest…

Study Tips & FAQ（学习建议与常见问题）

  • Synthesis reorganises shared themes and differences rather than merely listing four separate summaries. synthesis 不是罗列四篇内容，而是找共同点与差异后重新组织
  • Check word forms, nominalisation and source attribution after writing. 写作后检查三件事：word forms、nominalisation、引用来源
  • Avoid stitching notes together without a controlling topic sentence and concluding sentence. 常见问题：段落变成笔记拼接，缺少 topic sentence 与总结句

Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）

The Assessment Guide lists A1 Integrated Speaking in the Term 1 exam period. Check Moodle for your assigned session. 考核指南将 A1 综合口语安排在第一学期考试时段，个人场次以 Moodle 为准。

📝 本周练习思路与高分表达参考（Week 13 · Listening and Writing: Australian Animals（甘蔗蟾蜍与考拉））

  • Speaking / Writing 学术升级：先用自己的话概括核心观点（Processing Text & Transformation），再替换为学术表达（模糊限制语 tend to / arguably + 转述动词 contend / demonstrate + 名词化）。

What Is This（这是什么）

This page supports FS Core Text SDG 11.docx through sentence-by-sentence translation. The reading concerns Sustainable Cities and Communities and uses academic vocabulary and complex sentences. 这是 SDG 11 核心阅读文本（FS Core Text SDG 11.docx）的逐句翻译辅助页。原文是一篇关于「可持续城市与社区」的学术概要，语言偏学术，长难句较多。

How to Use（怎么用）

  • Open the graphic-notes tab and read paragraph by paragraph: each existing card places the English original (EN) above the Chinese translation. 打开「图文笔记」标签，按段落顺序对照阅读：每张卡片上方为英文原文（EN），下方为中文翻译。
  • Try to understand the English first, consulting Chinese when needed, and collect the highlighted terms and expressions. 先尝试自己读懂英文，卡住时再看中文；重点积累加粗/术语表达。
  • The text lists ten SDG 11 targets: seven numbered targets (11.1–11.7) and three lettered implementation targets (11.A–11.C). 核心文本列出十项目标，包括七项编号目标和三项字母编号的实施目标。

Key Focus（重点关注）

  • When citing a figure, record what it measures, where and when it applies, and its source paragraph. 引用数字时记下指标、适用地区和时间，以及所在段落。
  • In the Beijing case study, separate the policy measures from the reported air-quality outcomes. Use the relevant paragraph to support each point. 阅读北京空气污染治理案例时，区分政策措施和报告的空气质量变化，并为每一点找出原文依据。

Read the English before checking the translation, alongside the Reading Guide. 本页为 SDG 11 核心阅读文本（FS Core Text SDG 11.docx）的逐句翻译：上方英文原文（EN），下方中文对照。建议先读英文、再查中文，配合 Reading Guide 使用。

SDG11 – Sustainable Cities & Communities  Goal 11: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
可持续发展目标 11——可持续城市与社区。目标 11：建设包容、安全、具有韧性且可持续的城市和人类住区。

Course source（课程原文） · FS Core Text SDG 11.docx，可在本周资料下载区打开。

Targets（具体目标）
Targets (specific objectives)

11.1 By 2030, ensure access for all to adequate, safe and affordable housing and basic services and upgrade slums
目标 11.1：到 2030 年，确保人人获得适当、安全和负担得起的住房及基本公共服务，并改善贫民窟。
11.2 By 2030, provide access to safe, affordable, accessible and sustainable transport systems for all, improving road safety, notably by expanding public transport, with special attention to the needs of those in vulnerable situations, women, children, persons with disabilities and older persons
目标 11.2：到 2030 年，为所有人提供安全、负担得起、无障碍且可持续的交通系统，改善道路安全，特别是通过扩展公共交通，并特别关注弱势群体、妇女、儿童、残疾人和老年人的需求。
11.3 By 2030, enhance inclusive and sustainable urbanization and capacity for participatory, integrated and sustainable human settlement planning and management in all countries
目标 11.3：到 2030 年，在所有国家加强包容和可持续的城市化，以及参与式、综合和可持续的人类住区规划与管理能力。
11.4 Strengthen efforts to protect and safeguard the world’s cultural and natural heritage
目标 11.4：加强保护和保卫世界文化与自然遗产的努力。
11.5 By 2030, significantly reduce the number of deaths and the number of people affected and substantially decrease the direct economic losses relative to global gross domestic product caused by disasters, including water-related disasters, with a focus on protecting the poor and people in vulnerable situations
目标 11.5：到 2030 年，大幅减少因灾害（包括水相关灾害）造成的死亡人数和受影响人数，并显著减少相对于全球国内生产总值而言的直接经济损失，重点保护穷人和弱势群体。
11.6 By 2030, reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities, including by paying special attention to air quality and municipal and other waste management
目标 11.6：到 2030 年，减少城市不利的人均环境影响，包括特别关注空气质量和市政及其他废物管理。
11.7 By 2030, provide universal access to safe, inclusive and accessible, green and public spaces, in particular for women and children, older persons and persons with disabilities
目标 11.7：到 2030 年，为所有人提供安全、包容、无障碍的绿色和公共空间，特别是为妇女、儿童、老年人和残疾人。
11.A Support positive economic, social and environmental links between urban, peri-urban and rural areas by strengthening national and regional development planning
目标 11.A：通过加强国家和区域发展规划，支持城市、城郊和农村地区之间积极的经济、社会和环境的联系。
11.B By 2020, substantially increase the number of cities and human settlements adopting and implementing integrated policies and plans towards inclusion, resource efficiency, mitigation and adaptation to climate change, resilience to disasters, and develop and implement, in line with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030, holistic disaster risk management at all levels
目标 11.B：到 2020 年，大幅增加采用并实施综合性政策和计划的城市和人类住区，以促进包容、资源效率、减缓和适应气候变化、抗灾能力，并根据《2015–2030 年仙台减少灾害风险框架》，在各层面制定并实施全面的灾害风险管理。
11.C Support least developed countries, including through financial and technical assistance, in building sustainable and resilient buildings utilizing local materials
目标 11.C：支持最不发达国家，包括通过财政和技术援助，利用本地材料建设可持续且具有韧性的建筑。

Chapter 10: Inclusive, Safe, and Resilient Cities and Settlements – Summary（第 10 章：包容、安全、具有韧性的城市与住区——内容概要）

Introduction（引言（Introduction））

This chapter provides an overall assessment of the implementation of SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities), which aims to make cities inclusive, safe, resilient, and sustainable.
本章对可持续发展目标 11（可持续城市与社区）的实施情况进行了总体评估，该目标旨在建设包容、安全、具有韧性且可持续的城市。
The chapter argues that while cities offer immense potential for improving human welfare, rapid urbanization has exacerbated challenges such as housing shortages, traffic congestion, environmental pollution, and inadequate public spaces.
本章认为，尽管城市在改善人类福祉方面潜力巨大，但快速城市化加剧了住房短缺、交通拥堵、环境污染和公共空间不足等挑战。
Rather than widening the gap between the rich and the poor, creating congestion and pollution, and isolating urban residents from nature, the existence of cities should make people's lives better.
城市的存在应当让人民生活得更好，而不是拉大贫富差距、造成拥堵和污染，或将城市居民与大自然隔绝。
The common goals of city governance can be achieved using various solutions, with people placed at the center of governance and cities tailored locally for their residents.
城市治理的共同目标可以通过多种方案实现，即以人民为治理核心，并根据当地居民的需求量身打造城市。
The assessment draws on global data, regional comparisons, and specific policy responses to evaluate progress toward the seven specific targets of SDG 11, including adequate housing, sustainable transport, disaster risk reduction, and access to green public spaces.
该评估利用全球数据、区域比较和具体政策应对，来评价在实现可持续发展目标 11 的七项具体目标（包括充足住房、可持续交通、减少灾害风险以及获得绿色公共空间）方面取得的进展。
To structure the global assessment, the chapter selects four interconnected dimensions of city governance for detailed analysis: slum improvement, public transportation, environmental pollution, and open public space.
为构建全球评估框架，本章选取了城市治理的四个相互关联的维度进行详细分析：贫民窟改造、公共交通、环境污染和开放公共空间。
These dimensions are not isolated; each significantly impacts equitable housing, urban de-congestion, greenhouse gas reduction, and overall resident well-being.
这些维度并非孤立存在；每一项都显著影响公平住房、城市疏堵、温室气体减排以及居民的整体福祉。
The chapter then introduces National Urban Policy (NUP) as a strategic “package” approach for coordinating national and local actions to address urbanization challenges, noting that clear NUPs have been well demonstrated in Brazil, China, South Africa, and other countries.
接着，本章引入国家城市政策（NUP）作为一种战略性的「一揽子」方法，用于协调国家和地方行动以应对城市化挑战，并指出明确的国家城市政策已在巴西、中国、南非等国得到充分印证。
Following this, the chapter examines the unique impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on SDG 11, noting both temporary positive effects (e.g., reduced air pollution during lockdowns) and severe negative disruptions to economies, public finances, and service delivery.
在此基础上，本章考察了 COVID-19 疫情对可持续发展目标 11 的独特影响，既注意到暂时的积极效应（例如封锁期间空气污染减少），也注意到对经济、公共财政和服务供给的严重负面冲击。
The chapter emphasizes that cities have been on the frontline in responding to the pandemic.
本章强调，城市一直处于应对疫情的最前线。
A detailed case study of Beijing's successful air pollution control—particularly the reduction of PM2.5 concentrations by 53% between 2013 and 2019—is presented as a replicable model for developing countries grappling with smog.
本章详细介绍了北京成功治理空气污染的案例研究——特别是 2013 至 2019 年间 PM2.5 浓度下降 53%——并将其作为面临雾霾困扰的发展中国家的可复制范例。
The case highlights the importance of top-down target setting, regional coordination, technological innovation, and public participation.
该案例凸显了自上而下设定目标、区域协调、技术创新和公众参与的重要性。
The Swedish company IQAir and the United Nations Environment Programme have both praised Beijing as an example of successful policy implementation leading to air quality improvement, with the UNEP calling Beijing's experience “a model that can be used for reference” globally.
瑞典公司 IQAir 和联合国环境规划署都称赞北京是政策成功实施从而改善空气质量的典范，其中联合国环境规划署称北京的经验是可供全球「借鉴的范例」。
The chapter concludes with specific recommendations to accelerate SDG 11 implementation globally, emphasizing collaborative governance mechanisms, new technologies, urban renewal strategies, and the dissemination of best practices.
本章最后提出加速全球落实可持续发展目标 11 的具体建议，强调协作治理机制、新技术、城市更新战略以及最佳实践的传播。
Overall, despite pockets of progress, the chapter warns that the world is off-track to meet most SDG 11 targets by 2030, especially in low- and middle-income countries.
总体而言，尽管存在一些局部进展，本章警告称，世界偏离了到 2030 年实现大多数可持续发展目标 11 具体目标的轨道，在低收入和中等收入国家尤其如此。
The introduction closes by framing the urgency of the situation.
引言最后强调了这一形势的紧迫性。
Between 2016 and 2018, the global urbanization rate rose from 54.37% to 55.27%, with much of this growth occurring in regions where infrastructure and governance capacity lag behind population increases.
2016 年至 2018 年间，全球城市化率从 54.37% 上升至 55.27%，且大部分增长发生在基础设施和治理能力落后于人口增长的地区。
The proportion of the global urban population living in slums increased from 23% in 2016 to 24% in 2018, representing over 1 billion people.
全球城市人口中居住在贫民窟的比例从 2016 年的 23% 上升到 2018 年的 24%，相当于超过 10 亿人。
Housing affordability remains a universal challenge, with buyers needing more than five times their annual income to purchase a standard home, and renters spending over 25% of monthly income on rent.
住房可负担性仍是一项全球性挑战：购房者需要超过年收入五倍的资金才能购买一套标准住房，而租房者将月收入的 25% 以上用于房租。
According to the 16th Annual Demographia International Housing Affordability Survey, housing prices increased in some of the least affordable major markets over the past year.
根据第 16 届《Demographia 国际住房可负担性调查》，过去一年里一些最难以负担的主要市场的房价出现上涨。
Rental households often face severe financial strain, and for low-income families, inadequate housing and informal settlements remain the only options.
租房家庭往往面临严重的财务压力，而对低收入家庭来说，住房不足和非正规住区仍是唯一的选择。
These stark figures underscore the need for urgent, coordinated, and well-funded policy interventions.
这些严峻的数据凸显了采取紧急、协调且资金充足的政策干预的必要性。

Regional Disparities and Drivers of Slum Growth（区域差异与贫民窟增长的驱动因素）

Slum populations are increasing faster than they can be improved.
贫民窟人口的增长速度快于其被改善的速度。
While regions such as Europe, Northern America, Australia, and New Zealand are on track to meet SDG 11.1 (adequate housing), others show only moderate progress (Northern Africa, Western Asia, Central and Southern Asia) and some show limited or no progress (Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America, the Caribbean, Oceania except Australia/New Zealand).
尽管欧洲、北美、澳大利亚和新西兰等地区有望实现可持续发展目标 11.1（充足住房），但其他地区仅取得中等进展（北非、西亚、中亚和南亚），还有一些地区进展有限或毫无进展（撒哈拉以南非洲、拉丁美洲、加勒比地区，以及除澳大利亚/新西兰以外的大洋洲）。
Sub-Saharan Africa is the most critical region, with over half of its urban residents living in slums.
撒哈拉以南非洲是最严峻的地区，其超过一半的城市居民生活在贫民窟中。
The sustained growth of slums results from rapid urbanization, rising income polarization, and population growth rates that outpace the response capacity of urban governments.
贫民窟的持续扩张源于快速城市化、收入两极分化加剧，以及超过城市政府应对能力的人口增长率。
In many developing countries, low-income households have no choice but informal settlements, as formal housing is unaffordable.
在许多发展中国家，由于正规住房难以负担，低收入家庭别无选择，只能住进非正规住区。
The situation in North Africa and West Asia is showing a worsening trend, with housing affordability declining despite some policy efforts.
北非和西亚的形势正在恶化，尽管出台了某些政策努力，住房可负担性仍在下降。
Up to 24% of the world's urban population lived in slums in 2018, an increase of 1% over 2016, with more than 1 billion people living in slums and informal settlements globally.
2018 年，全球多达 24% 的城市人口生活在贫民窟中，比 2016 年上升了 1 个百分点，全球有超过 10 亿人生活在贫民窟和非正规住区。
The global urban slum population proportion has continued to increase in the past few years, with slums growing faster than they are being improved.
过去几年，全球城市贫民窟人口比例持续上升，贫民窟的扩张速度快于其改善速度。
This creates a high risk of failing to achieve SDG target 11.1 by 2030, which aims to ensure access for all to adequate, safe, and affordable housing.
这导致到 2030 年无法实现可持续发展目标 11.1（旨在确保人人获得充足、安全和负担得起的住房）的风险很高。

Government-Led and Market-Based Interventions（政府主导与基于市场的干预措施）

Governments and intergovernmental institutions like UN-Habitat have attempted two main approaches to address the slum crisis.
各国政府及联合国人居署等政府间机构尝试了两种主要方法来应对贫民窟危机。
First, government-led slum upgrading involves renovating city centers, demolishing slums, relocating residents, and then selling or leasing redeveloped land for higher-value urban development.
第一，政府主导的贫民窟改造包括翻新城市中心、拆除贫民窟、迁置居民，然后出售或租赁重新开发的土地以进行更高价值的城市开发。
This approach can clear slums quickly but risks displacing vulnerable populations without adequate alternative housing.
这种方法能迅速清除贫民窟，但存在在没有充分替代住房的情况下迫使弱势群体迁离的风险。
Second, “urban renewal” campaigns involve multiple actors: the market provides housing supply through market-oriented mechanisms, while governments supply low-rent or affordable housing for those unable to afford market rates.
第二，「城市更新」行动涉及多个主体：市场通过市场化机制提供住房供给，而政府为无力负担市场价格的群体提供低租金或经济适用房。
The government should guide and involve multiple subjects in the housing supply plan to improve overall supply.
政府应引导并动员多方主体参与住房供给计划，以改善整体供给。
In the process of rapid population gathering, if urban construction and management cannot keep up with rapidly growing demand, a series of contradictions will be triggered, resulting in housing shortages and numerous slums.
在人口快速聚集的过程中，如果城市建设和管理跟不上快速增长的需求，就会引发一系列矛盾，导致住房短缺和大量贫民窟的出现。
Countries have steadily improved urban slums and committed to ridding millions of people of poor living environments.
各国已稳步改善城市贫民窟，并承诺让数百万人摆脱恶劣的居住环境。
However, renewed political attention from business and political leaders, increased investments, and multi-level, multi-agent participation housing supply systems are essential.
然而，商界和政界领导人重新给予政治关注、增加投资，以及建立多层次、多主体参与的住房供给体系，都是必不可少的。
Without these, the goal of affordable and adequate housing for all by 2030 will almost certainly fail, leaving billions in substandard living conditions.
若缺乏这些，到 2030 年实现人人享有可负担且充足住房的目标几乎肯定会失败，使数十亿人生活在不达标的居住条件中。

The Failure of Car-Centric Planning（以汽车为中心规划的失败）

Traffic congestion is one of the most intractable urban problems, affecting virtually every major city worldwide.
交通拥堵是最棘手的城市问题之一，几乎影响全球每座主要城市。
Rapid urbanization, rising housing prices, and the legacy of “adapting to car development” policies (adopted by many cities in the late 20th century) have led to an explosion in private vehicle ownership.
快速城市化、房价上涨，以及许多城市在 20 世纪末采用的「适应汽车发展」政策的遗留影响，导致私家车拥有量激增。
This causes severe congestion, which in turn reduces economic productivity, increases pollution, creates safety hazards, and diminishes quality of life.
这造成了严重的拥堵，进而降低经济生产率、加剧污染、带来安全隐患，并降低生活质量。
For many young families forced to live in suburbs due to high inner-city housing costs, driving becomes the only feasible commuting option, while public transport is time-consuming, unreliable, or completely unavailable.
对于许多因市中心住房成本高而被迫住在郊区的年轻家庭来说，开车成为唯一可行的通勤方式，而公共交通则耗时、不可靠或完全缺失。
Ring expressways, intended to alleviate congestion, often become clogged soon after opening as induced demand fills the new capacity almost immediately.
旨在缓解拥堵的环城高速公路，往往一经开通就很快堵塞，因为诱增需求几乎立即填满了新的通行能力。
This “persistent urban disease” hinders development by causing the decline of economic and social functions and the continuous deterioration of the living environment.
这种「顽固的城市病」通过导致经济与社会功能衰退以及居住环境持续恶化，阻碍了发展。
Traffic congestion will not only lead to the decline of various economic and social functions but will also lead to the continuous deterioration of the city's living environment, becoming a major obstacle to sustainable urban development.
交通拥堵不仅会导致各种经济和社会功能衰退，还会导致城市居住环境持续恶化，成为城市可持续发展的主要障碍。

Smart Transportation and Shared Mobility Solutions（智能交通与共享出行解决方案）

Cities have implemented two key measures to combat congestion: increasing public transport supply and adopting smart transportation technologies.
各城市采取了两项关键措施来应对拥堵：增加公共交通供给和采用智能交通技术。
Regarding public transport supply, with the rise of internet technology, cities with large numbers of private cars began optimizing private car use.
关于公共交通供给，随着互联网技术的兴起，拥有大量私家车的城市开始优化私家车的使用。
In Paris, bike-sharing (2007) and electric vehicle sharing (2011) helped control single-driver vehicles.
在巴黎，共享单车（2007 年）和电动汽车共享（2011 年）有助于控制单人驾驶车辆。
Global ride-sharing companies (Uber, Didi) use privately owned vehicles as part of mobile travel solutions, potentially reducing private car ownership rates and improving traffic accessibility.
全球网约车公司（Uber、滴滴）将私家车纳入移动出行解决方案，有可能降低私家车拥有率并改善交通可达性。
Car sharing and carpooling help control or even reduce private car ownership rates.
汽车共享和拼车有助于控制甚至降低私家车拥有率。
Shenzhen's “rail+real estate” model finances infrastructure through land premiums, reducing government funding dependence by 50% while introducing some market risks.
深圳的「轨道+物业」模式通过土地溢价来为基础设施融资，使政府对资金的依赖降低了 50%，同时引入了一些市场风险。
Dubai plans to convert 25% of trips to autonomous travel by 2030, estimating a 44% cost reduction.
迪拜计划到 2030 年将 25% 的出行转为自动驾驶出行，预计可降低成本 44%。
Smart transportation systems using edge cloud facilities and central cloud platforms (as in Seoul) can reduce commuting time by 15–20% through optimized traffic control systems and driving behaviour analysis.
使用边缘云设施和中心云平台的智能交通系统（如首尔）可通过优化交通控制系统和驾驶行为分析，将通勤时间减少 15%–20%。
Despite these efforts, only 49% of urban residents in 467 cities (90 countries) had convenient access to public transport in 2019 – a 53% decline from 2018.
尽管做出了这些努力，2019 年 467 座城市（90 个国家）中仅有 49% 的城市居民能便捷地乘坐公共交通——较 2018 年下降了 53%。
Sub-Saharan Africa lags at just 35% access, and informal transport modes remain widely available in many low-access regions.
撒哈拉以南非洲的覆盖率仅为 35%，而在许多低覆盖地区，非正规交通方式仍广泛存在。
Faster progress is still needed globally, especially for developing countries.
全球仍需加快进展，对发展中国家而言尤其如此。

Sources and Health Impacts of Air Pollution（空气污染的来源与健康影响）

Residents in many big cities are deeply affected by air pollution, which causes nearly 7 million deaths annually, including 650,000 children under the age of five.
许多大城市的居民深受空气污染影响，空气污染每年导致近 700 万人死亡，其中包括 65 万名五岁以下儿童。
Air pollution increases risks of stroke, heart disease, lung cancer, and chronic and acute respiratory diseases including asthma.
空气污染增加了中风、心脏病、肺癌，以及包括哮喘在内的慢性和急性呼吸系统疾病的风险。
Over 90% of air pollution-related deaths occur in low- and middle-income countries, mainly in Asia and Africa.
超过 90% 与空气污染相关的死亡发生在低收入和中等收入国家，主要在亚洲和非洲。
In 2019, the top 10 countries with the worst air pollution were all in Asia.
2019 年，空气污染最严重的 10 个国家全部位于亚洲。
In 2016, 97% of cities with over 100,000 residents in low- and middle-income countries did not meet WHO air quality standards, compared to 49% in high-income countries.
2016 年，在低收入和中等收入国家中，居民超过 10 万人的城市里有 97% 未达到世界卫生组织的空气质量标准，而高收入国家这一比例为 49%。
Three billion people still rely on solid fuels (wood, coal, crop residues, and kerosene) for cooking, heating, and lighting, exposing them to dangerous fine particles, especially women and children who spend more time indoors.
仍有 30 亿人依赖固体燃料（木材、煤炭、农作物残余和煤油）做饭、取暖和照明，使他们暴露于危险的细颗粒物中，尤其是那些在室内时间更长的妇女和儿童。
The elderly, children, the sick, and the poor are more vulnerable to air pollution.
老人、儿童、病人和穷人更容易受到空气污染的危害。
Climate change exacerbates the problem by increasing the frequency and intensity of forest fires and sandstorms, as seen in Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Los Angeles, Australia, Indonesia, Brazil, and the United States.
气候变化通过增加森林火灾和沙尘暴的频率与强度加剧了这一问题，在新加坡、吉隆坡、曼谷、清迈、洛杉矶、澳大利亚、印度尼西亚、巴西和美国等地均有体现。
Air pollutants affect not only health but also ecosystems, food production, and climate patterns.
空气污染物不仅影响健康，还影响生态系统、粮食生产和气候模式。

Mitigation Strategies and Remaining Gaps（减缓策略与仍存在差距）

Cities have adopted two main strategies to combat air pollution.
各城市采取了两种主要策略来治理空气污染。
First, reducing emissions through clean energy plans: expanding renewable energy and electricity, eliminating coal, decarbonizing transportation and industry, avoiding future emissions, and implementing renewable energy sources (wind, solar, and hydroelectric).
第一，通过清洁能源计划减少排放：扩大可再生能源和电力、淘汰煤炭、推动交通和工业脱碳、避免未来排放，以及采用可再生能源（风能、太阳能和水电）。
Many recent studies have shown that actions to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions can quickly have positive impacts on economic and social welfare by improving public health and ecosystem sustainability.
许多近期研究表明，减缓温室气体排放的行动可通过改善公共健康和生态系统可持续性，迅速对经济和社会福祉产生积极影响。
India's Ujjwala Plan provided free liquefied petroleum gas connections to 37 million poor women living below the poverty line to support the switch to clean household energy.
印度的 Ujjwala 计划为 3700 万生活在贫困线以下的贫困妇女免费提供液化石油气连接，以支持其转向清洁的家庭能源。
Mexico City pledged smoke-free buses and a ban on private diesel vehicles by 2025.
墨西哥城承诺到 2025 年实现公交车无烟，并禁止私家柴油车。
Second, optimizing urban ecological space: “Forest City,” “Garden City,” and “Ecological City” have become planning concepts worldwide.
第二，优化城市生态空间：「森林城市」「花园城市」和「生态城市」已成为全球范围内的规划理念。
Research shows each tree can help reduce carbon emissions from power plants by about 10kg by reducing air conditioner demand through shade and evapotranspiration.
研究表明，每棵树通过遮荫和蒸腾作用减少对空调的需求，可帮助发电厂减少约 10 公斤的碳排放。
Examples include Singapore's skyscraper greening project, New York's Central Park, and London's construction of a national park city.
例子包括新加坡的摩天大楼绿化项目、纽约的中央公园，以及伦敦正在建设的国家公园城市。
Some governments promote coordinated climate-air pollution governance, as seen in Canada's Short-Lived Climate Pollutants policy (the world's first) and China's air pollution controls, which have become important driving forces for green transitions.
一些政府推动气候与空气污染协同治理，如加拿大的短寿命气候污染物政策（全球首个）和中国的空气污染控制措施，这些已成为绿色转型的重要推动力。
However, progress remains insufficient, with over half the world's population experiencing increased fine particulate matter between 2010 and 2016.
然而，进展仍然不足，2010 年至 2016 年间，全球超过一半的人口经历了细颗粒物浓度的上升。

The Benefits and Shortages of Public Space（公共空间的益处与不足）

Parks, boulevards, gardens, amusement parks, and streets provide essential social, economic, and mental health benefits.
公园、林荫大道、花园、游乐园和街道提供了重要的社会、经济和心理健康益处。
Public open spaces in cities can provide interactive places for people, play important roles in social and economic life, and are beneficial to the physical and mental health of urban residents.
城市中的公共开放空间能为人们提供互动场所，在社会和经济生活中发挥重要作用，并有益于城市居民的身心健康。
Walkable urban public recreational space (UPRS) is now a key planning concept, with some city governments aiming to create “community life circles” that ensure accessibility to daily living service facilities within convenient walking distance.
可步行城市公共休闲空间（UPRS）如今已成为一个关键的规划理念，一些城市政府旨在打造「社区生活圈」，确保在方便步行可达的范围内能够获得日常生活服务设施。
The successful transformation of street space into a walkable and dynamic place with the dual attribute of “traffic space-public space” helps create more human-centred urban environments.
将街道空间成功转变为兼具「交通空间—公共空间」双重属性的可步行、有活力的场所，有助于营造更以人为中心的城市环境。
Innovative projects have transformed abandoned infrastructure into public amenities – for example, New York's High Line (a disused railway turned into an elevated park and commercial area) successfully brought about the revival of the entire region.
创新项目将废弃的基础设施改造为公共便利设施——例如纽约的高线公园（一条废弃铁路改造为空中公园和商业区）成功带动了整个地区的复兴。
Some developing countries pursue “urban gardening” plans that combine design, architecture, and landscape interventions to stimulate new layers of urban life.
一些发展中国家推行「城市园艺」计划，将设计、建筑和景观干预相结合，以激发城市生活的新层次。
The activation of existing facilities through abandoned railway and factory conversions has proven effective worldwide.
通过改造废弃铁路和工厂来激活现有设施的做法，在全球范围内已被证明是有效的。
These efforts can create more human-centered environments and improve resident welfare.
这些努力能够营造更以人为中心的环境，并改善居民福祉。

Decline, Privatization, and Regional Gaps（衰退、私有化与区域差距）

Despite growing awareness, public space is often inadequate, poorly designed, or privatized due to financial pressures and commercial development impulses.
尽管公众意识不断增强，但由于财政压力和商业开发冲动，公共空间往往不足、设计糟糕或被私有化。
Cities become increasingly segregated as a result, with wealthy areas enjoying ample green space while poorer neighbourhood’s lack any public gathering areas.
其结果是城市日益分隔，富裕地区享有充足的绿地，而较贫穷的社区却缺乏任何公共聚集场所。
Based on data from 467 cities in 90 countries in 2019, few cities have been able to implement a system of open public spaces that covers entire urban areas within easy reach of all residents.
根据 2019 年 90 个国家 467 座城市的数据，很少有城市能够建立一套覆盖整个城市区域、且所有居民都易于到达的开放公共空间体系。
The average share of population within 400 meters walking distance of an open public space is only around 35% – down from 53% in 2018 and 59% in 2014.
平均而言，在开放公共空间 400 米步行距离内的人口比例仅约为 35%——低于 2018 年的 53% 和 2014 年的 59%。
This significant decline over time indicates that progress is moving backward, not forward, as commercial development pressures continue to erode existing public spaces.
这种随时间显著下降的趋势表明，随着商业开发压力持续侵蚀现有公共空间，进展是在倒退而非前进。
Regional disparities are stark: Australia/New Zealand (67%), North America/Europe (67%), Latin America/Caribbean (46%), West/North Africa (40%), sub-Saharan Africa (26%), Central/South Asia (26%), and East/South-East Asia (22%).
区域差异十分明显：澳大利亚/新西兰（67%）、北美/欧洲（67%）、拉美/加勒比（46%）、西/北非（40%）、撒哈拉以南非洲（26%）、中/南亚（26%），以及东亚/东南亚（22%）。
A low percentage does not necessarily mean the share of land in open public space is inadequate; rather, distribution and accessibility are poor, with many residents unable to reach existing spaces due to unsafe streets, lack of sidewalks, or distance.
比例低并不一定意味着开放公共空间的土地占比不足；相反，是分布和可及性较差，许多居民由于街道不安全、缺少人行道或距离过远而无法到达现有空间。
Few cities have implemented open public space systems covering entire urban areas.
很少有城市建立了覆盖整个城市区域的开放公共空间体系。

National Urban Policy as a Coordinating Framework（作为协调框架的国家城市政策）

National Urban Policies (NUPs) are coherent, government-led strategies that coordinate various actors toward a common vision for transformative, productive, inclusive, and resilient urban development.
国家城市政策（NUPs）是一致、由政府主导的战略，用于协调各方主体，共同实现变革性、高效、包容和具有韧性的城市发展愿景。
A NUP is a coherent set of decisions derived through a deliberate government-led process of coordinating and rallying various actors for a common vision and goal.
国家城市政策是一套一致的决策，源自政府主导的、为共同愿景和目标而协调并动员各方主体的审慎过程。
NUPs serve three key functions: First, they position state institutions as primary change agents, often using Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) for improved planning and service delivery.
国家城市政策发挥三项关键职能：第一，它们将国家机构定位为主要变革推动者，常利用公私合作伙伴关系（PPPs）来改善规划和服务供给。
While objectives may differ between more socially or economically driven motives, NUPs can be conceived as policy vehicles for state-led, private-involved approaches.
尽管目标可能因更偏社会性或经济性动机而不同，国家城市政策可以被视为国家主导、私人参与的政策载体。
Second, they integrate related policies (smart city plans, urban development plans, sustainable urban development plans) across different levels of government, linking cities, peri-urban areas, and villages, thus providing comprehensive solutions to the challenges posed by urbanization.
第二，它们在政府不同层级间整合相关政策（智慧城市计划、城市发展计划、可持续城市发展计划），连接城市、城郊地区和乡村，从而为城市化带来的挑战提供综合解决方案。
Third, they align national policies with SDG targets, subdividing them by important themes of the sustainable development agenda.
第三，它们使国家政策与可持续发展目标保持一致，并按可持续发展议程的重要主题对其进行细分。
The number of countries with NUPs increased from 142 in 2015 to 149 in 2017 and further to 150 in 2019, with nearly half fully implemented.
制定国家城市政策的国家数量从 2015 年的 142 个增加到 2017 年的 149 个，2019 年进一步增至 150 个，其中近一半已全面实施。
Brazil, China, and South Africa demonstrate successful NUP implementation.
巴西、中国和南非展示了国家城市政策的成功实施。

COVID-19's Dual Effect on SDG 11（COVID-19 对可持续发展目标 11 的双重影响）

The COVID-19 pandemic severely disrupted societies, economies, and public governance, representing the worst public health emergency of the 21st century.
COVID-19 疫情严重扰乱了社会、经济和公共治理，是 21 世纪最严重的公共卫生突发事件。
By April 2020, the virus had spread to all continents, challenging governance capacity at all levels.
到 2020 年 4 月，病毒已传播到所有大洲，对各层面的治理能力构成挑战。
The pandemic has had unprecedented effects, including severe disruption to societies and economies, global travel and commerce, and the livelihoods of people, particularly the poorest.
疫情造成了前所未有的影响，包括对社会和经济、全球旅行与商业，以及民众生计（尤其是最贫困人口）的严重破坏。
Stagnation reduced government revenues and personal incomes, directly affecting housing, transport, and public space construction.
停滞减少了政府收入和个人收入，直接影响了住房、交通和公共空间建设。
The impact of the crisis will reverse hard-won development gains and hinder progress toward achieving the SDGs.
这场危机的影响将逆转来之不易的发展成果，并阻碍实现可持续发展目标的进展。
However, there was a short-term positive effect: IQAir data showed air pollution in 10 major cities dropped 9–60% during lockdowns, with annual PM2.5 and PM10 averages potentially better than expected in 2020.
然而，也出现了短期的积极效应：IQAir 数据显示，封锁期间 10 座主要城市的空气污染下降了 9%–60%，2020 年的 PM2.5 和 PM10 年均浓度可能好于预期。
This improvement was temporary; as economies recover, air pollution remains a great challenge to the physical and mental health of urban residents worldwide.
这一改善是暂时的；随着经济恢复，空气污染仍是对全球城市居民身心健康的巨大挑战。
Overall, achieving SDG 11 by 2030 is a huge challenge, especially for developing countries with insufficient public financial resources.
总体而言，到 2030 年实现可持续发展目标 11 是一项巨大挑战，对公共财政资源不足的发展中国家尤其如此。
These countries are more likely to lack effective means to achieve the expected targets, requiring proactive national approaches and global coordination mechanisms to assist with common governance problems.
这些国家更可能缺乏实现预期目标的有效手段，需要主动的国家层面措施和全球协调机制来应对共同的治理问题。

Case Study – Beijing's Air Pollution Control（案例研究——北京的空气污染治理）

The Threat and Initial Conditions（威胁与初始条件）

Between 1996 and 2018, China's urbanization rate rose from 30% to 61%, bringing severe environmental challenges, most notably smog dominated by PM2.5. In 2017, Beijing's GDP, population, and vehicle ownership were 11.78 times, 1.74 times, and 4.35 times that of 1998, respectively, with per capita GDP exceeding US$20,000, a resident population of 21.7 million, and vehicle ownership of 5.99 million.
1996 年至 2018 年间，中国的城镇化率（urbanization rate）从 30% 上升至 61%，随之带来严峻的环境挑战，其中最突出的是以 PM2.5 为主的雾霾（smog）。2017 年，北京的 GDP、人口和机动车保有量分别是 1998 年的 11.78 倍、1.74 倍和 4.35 倍；其中人均 GDP 超过 US$20,000，常住人口达到 21.7 million，机动车保有量达到 5.99 million。
1996 年至 2018 年间，中国的城市化率从 30% 上升到 61%，带来了严峻的环境挑战，最显著的是以 PM2.5 为主的雾霾。2017 年，北京的 GDP、人口和机动车保有量分别是 1998 年的 11.78 倍、1.74 倍和 4.35 倍，人均 GDP 超过 2 万美元，常住人口 2170 万，机动车保有量 599 万辆。
The rapid development of the urban economy led to deteriorating air quality, with urban residents facing daily “smog” problems.
城市经济的快速发展导致空气质量恶化，城市居民每天都面临「雾霾」问题。
In 2013, Beijing's annual average PM2.5 concentration was 89.5μg/m³ – exceeding China's national air quality standard of 35μg/m³ and far above WHO's guideline of 10μg/m³.
2013 年，北京的 PM2.5 年均浓度为 89.5 微克/立方米——超过中国 35 微克/立方米的国家空气质量标准，更远高于世界卫生组织 10 微克/立方米的指导值。
Beijing established 35 PM2.5 monitoring stations in 2012 and began releasing pollutant monitoring data on January 1, 2013.
北京于 2012 年建立了 35 个 PM2.5 监测站，并于 2013 年 1 月 1 日开始发布污染物监测数据。
Through coordinated national, regional, and local efforts over many years, including systematic policy implementation and scientific methods, Beijing reduced PM2.5 concentration by 53% between 2013 and 2019.
通过多年国家、区域和地方层面的协调努力，包括系统性的政策实施和科学方法，北京在 2013 至 2019 年间将 PM2.5 浓度降低了 53%。
By 2020, Beijing had dropped off the list of the world's 200 most polluted cities.
到 2020 年，北京已跌出全球污染最严重 200 城之列。
The Swedish company IQAir considered Beijing an example of successful policy implementation leading to air quality improvement at a press conference on the release of testing data in 2020.
瑞典公司 IQAir 在 2020 年检测数据发布的记者会上，将北京视为政策成功实施从而改善空气质量的范例。
The United Nations Environment Programme's 2019 report also gave the same conclusion, praising Beijing's experience in air pollution control as “a model that can be used for reference” for the world.
联合国环境规划署 2019 年的报告也得出相同结论，称赞北京治理空气污染的经验是可供世界「借鉴的范例」。

Policy Measures and Public Participation（政策措施与公众参与）

Success rested on three pillars.
这一成功建立在三大支柱之上。
成功建立在三大支柱之上。
Success rested on three pillars.
First, top-down target setting: In 2016, China's National Plan on Implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development was released, providing overall guidance.
第一，自上而下设定目标：2016 年，中国发布了《落实 2030 年可持续发展议程国家方案》，提供了总体指导。
China's 13th Five-Year Plan (2016–2020) added two new air quality indicators (“ratio of days with good air quality in cities at prefecture level and above” and “PM2.5 concentration drop in cities where PM2.5 is not up to standard”), creating incentives for local governments.
中国的「十三五」规划（2016–2020）新增了两项空气质量指标（「地级及以上城市空气质量优良天数比例」和「PM2.5 未达标城市浓度下降」），为地方政府创造了激励。
Second, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei coordinated governance: the region reduced coal consumption by 71 million tons (2012–2017), adjusted industrial structure toward low-energy sectors (information technology, biology, high-end equipment manufacturing, new energy), eliminated surplus production capacity of energy-intensive industries, and cut motor vehicle fuel use through subsidies for new energy vehicles (purchase subsidies, charging piles, expanded new energy buses).
第二，京津冀协同治理：该地区在 2012–2017 年间减少了 7100 万吨煤炭消费，将产业结构向低能耗行业（信息技术、生物、高端装备制造、新能源）调整，淘汰高耗能行业的过剩产能，并通过新能源汽车补贴（购车补贴、充电桩、扩大新能源公交车）减少机动车燃油使用。
Consequently, Beijing's PM2.5 fell to 58μg/m³ in 2017, meeting the State Council's target.
因此，北京的 PM2.5 在 2017 年降至 58 微克/立方米，达到了国务院的目标。
Third, Beijing's local measures included seven categories: coal-fired boiler renovation, clean-up of civil fuels, industrial structure adjustment, emission control of mobile sources, upgrading of industrial standards, comprehensive dust control, and treatment of volatile organic compounds.
第三，北京的本地措施包括七大类：燃煤锅炉改造、民用燃料清理、产业结构调整、移动源排放控制、工业标准升级、综合扬尘治理，以及挥发性有机物治理。
Public participation was crucial: carbon trading pilots (launched in 2011 in seven regions), information disclosure through all-media communications platforms (newspaper, radio, television, internet, Weibo, WeChat), environmental hotlines, online complaint mailboxes, and cash incentives (up to 50,000 Yuan per case) encouraged reporting of violations.
公众参与至关重要：碳交易试点（2011 年在七个地区启动）、通过全媒体传播平台（报纸、广播、电视、互联网、微博、微信）进行信息公开、环保热线、在线投诉信箱，以及现金奖励（每案最高 5 万元）鼓励举报违规行为。
Beijing's “common governance and sharing” plan mobilized the whole city.
北京的「共治共享」计划动员了整座城市。
Strong public support and multi-stakeholder co-governance were key to success.
强有力的公众支持和多方利益相关者共同治理是成功的关键。
Nevertheless, Beijing's PM2.5 remains above WHO's minimum standard (35μg/m³), indicating that thorough improvement is a long-term task requiring participation of all citizens.
尽管如此，北京的 PM2.5 仍高于世界卫生组织的最低标准（35 微克/立方米），这表明彻底改善是一项需要全体市民参与的长期任务。
Beijing's experience provides a reference model for urban air pollution control in developing countries worldwide.
北京的经验为全球发展中国家的城市空气污染治理提供了一个参考模式。

③ 重点词汇巩固

本周关键表达：SDG 11（Sustainable Development Goal 11: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable. 中文：可持续发展目标 11（可持续城市与社区））、National Urban Policy (NUP)（In the core reading, a National Urban Policy is a coordinating government framework for urban development across actors and policy areas. 中文：国家城市政策）、slum（A heavily populated urban area characterised by substandard housing and inadequate access to basic services. 中文：贫民窟）、urbanization（The process by which an increasing proportion of a population lives in cities and suburbs. 中文：城市化）、PM2.5（PM2.5 is fine particulate matter with a diameter of 2.5 micrometres or less, used as an air-pollution measure in the reading. 中文：细颗粒物（直径 ≤ 2.5 微米））、resilience（The capacity of cities and communities to absorb, recover from and adapt to shocks such as disasters or pandemics. 中文：韧性（抗灾/恢复能力））。建议为每个表达造一个与本周话题相关的句子，并朗读/录音回听，检查发音与语调。

④ 阅读（Reading）专项提分

逐句翻译后做回译练习，检验是否真正读懂；用术语表复述每段主旨；把生词做成词汇卡，结合上下文而非孤立记忆。
